title: The minilogue xd: the minilogue with the prologue’s digital engine
intro: Korg began its “logue” series in 2016 with the minilogue, a four-voice analogue polysynth with 37 slim keys and a polyphonic step sequencer. The monophonic monologue followed, and in 2018 the prologue, the series’ flagship, added a digital multi-engine and DSP effects. The minilogue xd, released in 2019, takes the prologue’s analogue voice, multi-engine and effects into the minilogue’s four-voice, 37-key format, and adds microtuning and an expanded sequencer.

timeline.name: Korg minilogue
timeline.text: A four-voice analogue polysynth with two VCOs per voice, two- and four-pole resonant low-pass filters, 200 presets, a polyphonic step sequencer and 37 slim keys.

timeline.name: Korg monologue
timeline.text: A monophonic sibling with two VCOs, an MS-20-style filter, a drive control, microtuning, a step sequencer and 25 slim keys.

timeline.name: Korg prologue
timeline.text: The flagship of the series: an analogue polysynth with a digital multi-engine and DSP effects, with 8 or 16 voices.

timeline.name: Korg minilogue xd
timeline.text: Four analogue voices of two VCOs each, the digital MULTI ENGINE (noise, a VPM oscillator or user oscillators), a low-pass VCF with drive, modulation, delay and reverb effects, a 16-step sequencer with motion, voice modes, an arpeggiator, microtuning and a joystick.

timeline.name: Korg minilogue xd module
timeline.text: The same instrument without the keys, with its sixteen buttons as a keyboard, and poly chain to join two units for eight voices.

relatives.name: Korg Polysix
relatives.text: An earlier Korg polysynth whose chord-memory mode played a stored chord from a single key, as the minilogue xd’s CHORD voice mode does with its fourteen built-in chords.

relatives.name: Yamaha DX7
relatives.text: The digital FM synthesizer of the 1980s, its sine-wave operators modulating each other. The MULTI ENGINE’s VPM oscillator works the same way with one carrier and one modulator.

relatives.name: Korg NTS-1
relatives.text: A small digital kit synthesizer from the same year that runs custom oscillators and effects written with the logue SDK, as the MULTI ENGINE’s USR slots and the user effects do.
